fullDescription: Home dashboard view that renders the default github-home-dashboard state with a top header, repository sidebar, central feed composer, trending and recommended repository cards, and right-side Copilot Day and changelog panels using shared presentational components.

Reusable presentational dashboard component for the github-home-dashboard view. It accepts serializable props for state, username, search placeholders, repository lists, feed cards, and changelog items, while keeping visible buttons, dropdowns, and search fields interactive through local UI state for immediate use and future route-driven reuse.
